A '''holoplaque''' was a device capable of displaying a still [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] image.<ref name="Omens" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' to "eight years after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]," for a date of [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Keleman Ciro]], [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'', used a holoplaque to capture an image of the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] command crew just prior to the start of their [[DarkStryder Campaign|mission]] to track down the rogue [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]].<ref name="Omens" />

==Behind the scenes==
The holoplaque is mentioned in the [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure "[[Omens]]",<ref name="Omens" /> which was included in the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' published by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]].<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref>
